lines: We sprinted through the criminal city again.
Most of what I wanted to know had become clear from the werewolf's words.
「There are some guys who've put a huge bounty on you folks――Well, the briefcase you're carrying, to be precise. It's an incubus terrorist organization.」
There was a demonic herb known as Hell Mandrake.
It was a rare plant that grew in remote corners of the Demon World, said to make its strange, big flowers bloom only once in a hundred years.
The ingredient extracted from its petals had extreme aphrodisiac and forced estrus effects. If even a single drop entered your body, you were done for.

For anyone whatsoever, it would raise the sensitivity of their entire body, cause hypertrophy or futanari-zation of the genitals, and turn them into a perverted, lustful pig who couldn't think about anything but sex......
Going by what the werewolf said――
The incubus organization appeared to be plotting to use this wonder drug to commit a large-scale aphrodisiac terrorist attack.
「'Cuz the more humans who lose themselves in desire, the better it is for them, right?」
「They probably plan to use this wonder drug as a foothold to expand their influence.」
「That's unforgivable! I think things like that should be done between people who love each other!」
「That's your problem with it......? Well, there no doubt it's a heinous plan.」
I agreed, and the werewolf explained further as we ran through the back alleys.
「Yeah. Also――for this plan, the incubi were using a slave trader group that's based around these parts.」
The orcs' organization that we had just infiltrated and busted.
「It seems their main business of slave trading has been on the decline lately, see?」
「So, they started taking on errands—or rather, subcontracted jobs—for other organizations.」
Among those subcontracted jobs was a commission from the incubi.
A facility with advanced equipment would be necessary to mass-purify the whoreweed wonder drug.
Accordingly, the incubi had commissioned a collaborating organization in the human world to purify it――
And entrusted the BS Gang with receiving and transporting the finished product.
The smallish briefcase that Una had carried away from the safe in the BS Gang's base.
Certainly, the inside was packed full of a large amount of what appeared to be drugs, which gave off a suspicious glow.
「You guys're the ones who attacked that small-time organization, right?」
「Those incubus guys know that, and they put a bounty on the case with the wonder drug in it.」
「They spread its location and description on the underworld's infonet, and some money-hungry guys snapped at that.」
I breathed a sigh, and looked at the briefcase that I held under my arm.
Man. I'd gotten caught up in some serious trouble, as usual.
「Yeah. I think it would be best to take it straight back to Gosha and seal it away......」
Going by his story, the contents of this briefcase were considerably dangerous materials. We couldn't afford to leave it here.
「Can't say I'm in a respectable line of work myself, but I don't like aggressive methods like those guys'.」
I asked the werewolf running beside me.
About the fact that he was aiding us.
Sure, his organization owed me one over the zombie gas incident before.
Hebiko, with whom he was infatuated, wasn't here today, either.
「That's...... Well, I got my own reasons too.」
「I wantcha to do something about my Kyoudai, who messed up.」(TL: “Brother”, in a gang member sense.)
「Yeah. Young in our organization, name of “Torajiro”.」
「Dunno what the problem was, but suddenly Tora's chewin' me out over everything, then just walks out on the group.」
「Well, if that were all, I'd say, 『Have it your way!!』 and leave the jerk to it, but――」
「That big idiot got brainwashed by those incubus guys and made their underling, of all things.」
「That's right. The guys from the terrorist organization that's chasing you.」
The werewolf nodded with a bitter expression.
「Tora's a beastman, like me――A weretiger, with a really good nose.」
「I'm sure the incubus guys'll make Tora sniff out the scent of the demon herb and chase after you.」
「I'm waiting for that――so I can free that asshole from the incubus shitheads.」
Certainly, it did seem that a sweet, enchanting scent was leaking very faintly from the briefcase.
If he used his sharp beastman nose, tracking this would probably be trivial.
「Wolf-san's passionate feelings for his Kyoudai!!! Fuuma-san, let's help him too!」
「She's right, Fuuma-kun! All men are brothers; when one's in trouble, we help each other!」
「Well, I'd like to do so as well, but......」
I also had a debt of gratitude to this werewolf for having saved us from that predicament earlier. I'd like to lend a hand if I could, but――
「But Una-chan, Mari-chan-senpai. The item in that case—the whoreweed wonder drug—is far too dangerous.」
「Isn't it our top priority to take that out of this criminal city first?」
「Ah, Mai-chan...... That may be so, but......」
Mari was suddenly at a loss for words, and the werewolf shrugged his shoulders with a wry smile.
「Hey, I wasn't really expecting your guys's help.」
「As the “big brother”, it's my responsibility to do something about Tora――But be careful.」
「To be frank, Tora's got as much power as me――maybe more.」
「Whether you fight or run, you guys're bound to have a hell of a hard time.」
When we had fought the werewolf previously, we had been forced into a hard fight, even with four Taimanin.
If he was more powerful than that――
I swallowed my saliva, and sharpened my alertness about our surroundings.
